data.title: Anutin silent on MP scam links
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul on Monday declined to comment on allegations linking the husband of Bhumjaithai (BJT) MP Suchada Zhang Thaensap to scam networks, as well as claims that the allegations are part of an attempt to block her father from becoming a minister.

data.title: Clashes erupt outside Kosovo parliament over war crimes court
data.description: - Police clashed with demonstrators outside Kosovo's parliament on Monday, as protesters demanded the passage of a bill that would curb the powers of the country's war crimes court.

data.title: At Oct 7 memorial, Netanyahu says will be no Hamas rule in Gaza
data.description: JERUSALEM - Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Monday vowed there would be no Hamas rule in Gaza as he attended a memorial event marking three years since the militant group's October 7, 2023 attack.

data.title: UN rights council slams Taliban's 'oppression' of women
data.description: GENEVA - The United Nations' Human Rights Council on Monday unanimously urged the Taliban to repeal all practices restricting the fundamental freedoms of women and girls, saying Afghanistan's institutionalised discrimination should shock humanity.

data.title: Bolsonaro rides right-wing surge into Brazil's election runoff
data.description: BRASíLIA - Right-wing Senator Flavio Bolsonaro heads to an October 25 runoff election from a position of strength, riding a conservative wave that has left President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva facing a tough battle to win a fourth term.

data.title: Ukraine says using AI robot guns to shoot down new Russian drones
data.description: KYIV — Ukraine has begun using artificial intelligence-enabled robot guns to take down Russia's new and fast-moving jet-powered drones, the Ukrainian air force said Monday.

data.title: Former Prince Andrew files legal action against UK police after arrest
data.description: LONDON — Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor, formerly known as Prince Andrew, has begun legal action against the British police force that arrested him and searched his properties this year as part of its investigation into his links to Jeffrey Epstein.

data.title: Disgraced former US House speaker dies at 84
data.description: WASHINGTON — Dennis Hastert, the longest-serving Republican speaker of the US House of Representatives whose career ended in disgrace after he admitted sexually abusing teenage boys he had coached, has died aged 84, officials said Monday.

data.title: Spain's PM calls snap election after housing bill defeat
data.description: MADRID - Spain's prime minister on Monday called a snap election for November 29, after the country's parliament rejected housing relief measures proposed by his minority government amid nationwide protests.

data.title: Court approves 12-day detention for activist Atchariya
data.description: The Criminal Court on Monday approved a police request to detain activist Atchariya Ruangrattanapong for 12 days and rejected his bail application.

data.title: Alleged Indian leader of neo-Nazi child abuse ring goes on trial in Paris
data.description: PARIS — An Indian man went on trial in Paris on Monday, accused of running a neo-Nazi child exploitation ring in which young girls were allegedly coerced into performing sexual acts online and engaging in self-harm.

data.title: Two dead, 11 rescued after fire onboard ship in Black Sea
data.description: BUCHAREST - Romanian authorities said on ​Monday that two people ‌had died and others had been rescued after a fire on a ship in the Black Sea outside Romania's territorial waters.

data.title: Slovenian glacier, tracked since 1946, could disappear within days
data.description: MOUNT ​TRIGLAV — Once a magnet for ​summer skiers and cherished by generations as a ​symbol of Slovenia's Alpine heritage, ‌one of the country's last glaciers has dwindled to a few patches of ice that researchers say could disappear within days.

data.title: Bryde's whale sighted feeding off Sichang island
data.description: CHON BURI - A Bryde's whale has been spotted feeding close to Koh Sichang, surfacing with its mouth open as it chased shoals of anchovies, to the delight of residents and tourists.

data.title: Thailand, Malaysia agree on future Hat Yai flood relief
data.description: Authorities in Songkhla and Malaysia have reportedly agreed on a plan to improve delivery of aid supplies to victims of future flooding in Hat Yai, ahead of the arrival of the northeast monsoon next month.

data.title: Storm topples tree, poles, blocks road in Sathon
data.description: A thunderstorm and heavy rain struck down powerpoles and a large tree on Suan Phlu Road in Bangkok's Sathon district on Monday afternoon, disrupting traffic.

data.title: Hundreds of French high schools shut as protests persist
data.description: PARIS — Lessons were suspended at hundreds of French high schools on Monday, as part of a wave of student protest over learning conditions that have rocked the European nation.

data.title: Molly turns 20
data.description: Pop Mart Thailand, together with Chulalongkorn University Property Management and the Tourism Authority of Thailand, launched the “Molly 20th Anniversary Exhibition – Bangkok” under the theme “The Little Galaxy – A Journey Through The Universe Of Time”. The Molly mania is taking place at Chulalongkorn University Centenary Park until Oct 25.

data.title: Airline baggage backlog almost cleared
data.description: Thai Airways International (THAI) announced on Monday it had reduced the backlog on delivery of passengers' luggage from flights through Suvanabhumi airport to 862 bags.

data.title: Ngern Tid Lor PLC Wins Two Major Awards at HR Asia Awards 2026
data.description: Ngern Tid Lor Public Company Limited , a subsidiary of Tidlor Holdings (TIDLOR) , has earned recognition on the Asian stage with two major awards at the HR Asia Awards 2026 . The company received the HR Asia Best Companies to Work for in Asia Award - Thailand 2026 for the third consecutive year, as well as the HR Asia People Transformation Awards . The awards reflect its commitment to creating a workplace where employees have opportunities to grow, learn, and continually develop their potential while helping drive sustainable business growth. Miss Nutchanart Arpamongkol , Chief People Officer, and Mr. Kanjanat Chalermjulamanee , Head of Tidlor Academy, accepted the awards on behalf of the company.
